PERQUISITION // BLOC 14, ESCALIER D, A: HOME SEARCH  //  BLOCK 14, STAIRCASE D, FLAT 7
Un logement d'une pièce, quai des Tanneu:
A one-room flat on Tanners' Quay. Marta PETRAS is lying down, short of breath; she does not get up. The little boy stands in front of her, as if to hide her.

"My husband is at the factory. What are you looking for in our home?"

You have time to search four places.
Derrière deux boîtes vides, des denrées: Behind two empty tins, goods without a State label: sugar, coffee, flour, wrapped in newspaper. Slipped at the back, a numbered queue token, dated on a Thursday.
Une ordonnance au nom de Marta PETRAS :: A prescription in the name of Marta PETRAS: a heart treatment, marked "not available from State pharmacies". The paper is worn from being shown.
Des reçus du mont-de-piété de la rue Bas: Pawn tickets from the pawnshop on Low Street: a wedding ring and a man's watch, pledged on 10 and 24 October. Neither has been redeemed.
Sous le plancher, près du poêle: Under the floor, by the stove
Vous soulevez la lame que le gamin regar: You lift the board the boy kept looking at. Beneath it: nothing. Not a leaflet, not a list, not an address. Only dust and an old tin toy.
Un cahier d'écolier et, dessus, une list: A school exercise book and, on top, a pencilled list in a child's hand: "for mum: medicine, oranges, dad's train". The child takes the book back from you without a word.
Marta PETRAS n'a pas bougé du lit. En pa: Marta PETRAS has not moved from the bed. As you leave, you hear the little boy ask her quietly whether they will come back. She does not answer.
